changes.title: 120 active runs: 20 for each of six classes
changes.text: APD now provides a class-first six-button selector with 20 scrollable active-run entries per class, each marked occupied or empty with saved floor, difficulty, challenges, Custom Dungeon Rules and last-played context.

changes.title: Verify original save preservation and cross-class isolation
changes.text: All six character classes, 20 independent slots each, 120 persisted physical folders, preserved original game1..6 IDs, no accidental cross-class overwrite, class-local deletion, actual save/load inventories, saved difficulty and rules are core tested; API34 class picker and scrolling assertions added.

changes.title: Preserve independent turn-history model and release traceability
changes.text: The independently added pure TurnHistory model and tests remain on the Codex branch, distinct from the active-save feature; note the full 1859 green core tests and request TEST284 against TEST283's actual compiled history.
